contributions.detail: THE RHODES SPECIMEN, and it behaves exactly as the brief documents. Form A's seven rows sum to 100 + 100 + 100 + 50 + 202.50 + 550 + 591.59 = 1,694.09, which equals cover LINE 1. The LAST-REPORT column is blank (first report of the cycle) and THIS == CUMULATIVE, so the two scopes coincide; recorded as cumulative. BISTABLE COVER GLYPH: the line-1 CUMULATIVE cell's leading digit reads as a '4' to the eye at 1200 dpi (i.e. '4,694.09') while the THIS cell reads '1,694.09'. The value recorded is 1,694.09 because the document's own arithmetic decides it and outranks any glyph re-read at any resolution: Form A sums to 1,694.09; blank LAST + 1,694.09 THIS must give 1,694.09 CUMULATIVE; line1 + line2 = 1,694.09 + 105.00 = 1,799.09 = the line-3 CUMULATIVE expense figure; and line 4 balance is 0. Nothing closes under 4,694.09. Both readings are reported here so the reversal is auditable. Line 2 (aggregate of $50.00 or less) is 105.00 and is NEVER itemized - Form A was scored against line 1 only, per the sub-$50 rule. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

expenditures.basis: cover-line3-cumulative (1,799.09) - the closest printed anchor; the side does NOT close against it
expenditures.detail: Form B's fourteen rows sum to 1,797.09 as transcribed. TWO competing printed anchors, both reported: the line-3 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell reads 1,799.01 and the line-3 CUMULATIVE cell reads 1,799.09 - the filer disagrees with himself in the last digit, and both are transcribed verbatim rather than one being picked. The rows match NEITHER, so this is a delta of 2.00 against the cumulative figure (2.08 against the this-report figure) and every row of the side carries needs_review:1. CAUSE TRACED TO ONE CELL: row 2 (Square One Printing, Postcards) reads 46.24 to the eye but its second digit is bistable 6/8 at every resolution tried including a 2400 dpi single-cell crop on both copies of this report. Under 48.24 the schedule would sum to 1,799.09 and close the cumulative anchor EXACTLY. The row was NOT adjusted to make it close, per the brief; 46.24 is published verbatim and the arithmetic finding is recorded here. The only other single-cell way to close would be row 6 reading 9.48 instead of 7.48, and that cell is unambiguous at 1200 dpi. Scope is cumulative: LAST is blank (first report of the cycle) and the rows span the whole campaign, matching the cumulative column's magnitude.

gates.balance_chain: Cover: contributions 1,694.09 (over $50) + 105.00 (<=$50 aggregate) = 1,799.09 in; expenses 1,799.09 out; line-4 balance 0 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns - the FILER'S cover closes exactly, which is itself the strongest evidence that his intended expense total is 1,799.09 (and hence that the 2.00 shortfall in the transcribed Form B sits in the one bistable cell, not in his addition). The LAST-REPORT column is blank on every line: this is the first report of the cycle. CROSS-FILING CHAIN: the other Rhodes document in this chunk is not a later report to chain to - it is THE SAME REPORT re-transmitted (see notes), with identical cover figures and identical schedules, so no forward chain exists and a naive cycle sum over the two would DOUBLE COUNT.

notes: index.csv gives candidate 'Shannon Rhodes', office 'County Council' - the cover reads 'Full Name of Candidate: Shannon Rhodes', 'Name of Office: Cache County Council', 'Office District: Northeast', party Democratic. County office, in scope. *** THE TWO RHODES DOCUMENTS IN THIS CHUNK ARE THE SAME REPORT. *** Both covers are signed '10/29/18' and carry identical figures on all four lines, and their Form A (7 rows) and Form B (14 rows) are identical line for line. This copy carries a fax header reading 'DEC/05/2018/WED 09:58 AM ... P.002' on every page; the other copy (bc7ce2f3) carries an 'OCT/30/2018/TUE 07:19 AM ... P.002/005' header and an October clerk stamp. The chunk file labels bc7ce2f3 as the 2018-10-30 filing and 00b019d3 as the 2018-12-05 'final'; the FORM says both are the 10/29/18 report, and the form governs. Treat them as one report transmitted twice, NOT as an interim plus a summary: adding their itemised rows together would double-count the entire 2018 cycle. The PDF holds report pages 1-4 (cover, Form A, Form B, statute); the fax numbering starts at P.002, so the missing P.001 is the fax cover sheet, not a report page - the report is complete. This copy is the cleaner scan of the two and was used for the hardest re-reads. Every Form B date cell prints MONTH AND DAY ONLY with no year, so all 14 expenditure dates are blank + needs_review per contract, with the verbatim in each row note; Form A's dates do carry two-digit years and parse cleanly. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN passed on both sides: Form A has 7 dates / 7 names / 7 addresses / 7 amounts, Form B 14 / 14 / 14 / 14, every date cell date-shaped and every name cell name-shaped. Donor street addresses, PO boxes and ZIPs are printed in the clear on Form A and the candidate's home street address, ZIP and home phone on the cover - all discarded at read time; only city is emitted, and no state is emitted because the filer wrote none.
